verdict.rationale: Supermemory's docs describe container tags as the primary isolation mechanism and a hard namespace boundary: memories in one tag are never returned by a search scoped to another. Developers are told to scope each end-user or tenant to its own tag, and code examples pass `containerTag` on both add and search. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-agent or per-application scoping (the docs only show per-user/tenant tags and team spaces), and independent or hands-on corroboration that cross-tag leakage never occurs.
